notes.title: PiMon Game Update Version 0.0.6
notes.content:
Hello, admins!

-Pressing "R" on your keyboard while the game is active will now both resize your PiMon window to its default size and put it in the top left corner of your main monitor.

-If you have a stat maxed out and win a minigame that should raise those stats, the game will now clarify that that specific stat is currently maxed out.

That's all this time around. Hope you will continue to assist us in learning more about PiMon!

notes.title: PiMon Update Version 0.0.3
notes.content:
Hello Admins!

Some changes to how save resets work. If you want to reset your save file completely press backspace on your keyboard while the game is active. A prompt will show up and pressing backspace again will reset your save file.

It should be noted that this option is for a clean slate and under most circumstances would not be required for regular play. If you wish to try a different evolutionary line for your PiMon you can do so with the "Soft Reset" button instead!

notes.title: PiMon Game Update Version 0.0.2
notes.content:
Hello, Admins!

It has now been a week since the release of PiMon! Thank you for trying out PiMon and for your continuous feedback. The following updates have been made to the game:

-Visual Changes in regards to the emotes your PiMon can do.

-Fixed a bug where the "Find Twinekopi's Secret" achievement was not consistently unlocking.

-There is now a pause button in the game, you can press this button to pause your game and then click anywhere on the screen to unpause!

notes.title: PiMon Game Update Version 0.0.1
notes.content:
Hello, admins!

PiMon is finally available to be enjoyed by anyone and everyone. I hope you are enjoying your time with your PiMon! These two days we have received very valuable feedback regarding the game and believed it was important to add these updates as soon as possible.

-Minigames and the Tutorial Menu now has a new "Resize" button that you can click to enlarge the screen for better visibility.

-PiMon energy depletes slower and PiMon are now less frequently prone to wanting to sleep to help make the game a more relaxing passive experience when admins are busy with other activities.

-You can now press, "Backspace" on your keyboard when our Studio logo appears to completely restart and reset the game. (Warning: This option is meant for those who might be having some very rare compatibility issues while transferring save files from the demo or other critical errors and should generally not be needed otherwise!)

We understand that there are quite a few keyboard macros in the game now so here's a visual rundown of the game's macros (This is available in game now as well):

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149480/7a45d38e7d337970cb929249b4f264ba04c5e912.png[/img]

Image of the keyboard sourced from [url=https://opengameart.org/content/keyboard]OpenGameArt[/url]

notes.title: Small Update and Some Features
notes.content:
Hiya!

So there was a bug where your PiMon egg could get stuck in the various training rooms throughout the game. This is an update to let you know this has been fixed in the newest version of the Demo and the as-of-yet unreleased full version.

Additionally the game has some new key macros:

-Press "R" on your keyboard to reset the size of the game window.

-Press "K" on your keyboard to be able to move to other monitors in case of a multimonitor setup.

-Press "+ -" on your keyboard's numpad, or "Z X" on your keyboard to adjust the game's volume
